sql: /* Reject conflicting same-sequence payloads before building; identical replays are harmless. */ WITH versions AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC NULLS FIRST) AS VERSION_RANK FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.INVOICE_CDC) SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, CAST(INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE, CAST(AMOUNT_CENTS AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS AMOUNT_CENTS, LOWER(TRIM(STATUS)) AS STATUS, CAST(SEQUENCE AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS SOURCE_SEQUENCE FROM versions WHERE VERSION_RANK = 1 AND NOT IS_DELETED

WITH versions AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC NULLS FIRST) AS VERSION_RANK FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.PAYMENT_CDC) SELECT TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID, INVOICE_ID, CAST(PAID_CENTS AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS PAID_CENTS, CAST(SEQUENCE AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS SOURCE_SEQUENCE FROM versions WHERE VERSION_RANK = 1 AND NOT IS_DELETED

/* Full identical snapshots replay safely. Differing overlapping histories must fail preflight. */ SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEGMENT, CAST(VALID_FROM AS DATE) AS VALID_FROM, CAST(VALID_TO AS DATE) AS VALID_TO FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.CUSTOMER_HISTORY

/* This requires the independently inventoried CSV to have been landed in RAW.ADJUSTMENTS. */ /* Duplicate adjustment keys are errors, including identical duplicates; never deduplicate them here. */ SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, CAST(ADJUSTMENT_CENTS AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) AS ADJUSTMENT_CENTS, REASON FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.ADJUSTMENTS
SELECT TENANT_ID || '|' || CUSTOMER_ID || '|' || STRFTIME(VALID_FROM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CUSTOMER_KEY, TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEGMENT, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_CUSTOMER_HISTORY

WITH payment_totals AS (SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS PAID_CENTS FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_PAYMENTS GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID), invoice_values AS (SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID, i.CUSTOMER_ID, i.INVOICE_DATE, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', i.INVOICE_DATE) AS DATE) AS INVOICE_MONTH, i.STATUS, i.AMOUNT_CENTS, COALESCE(a.ADJUSTMENT_CENTS, 0) AS ADJUSTMENT_CENTS, i.AMOUNT_CENTS + COALESCE(a.ADJUSTMENT_CENTS, 0) AS NET_CENTS, COALESCE(p.PAID_CENTS, 0) AS PAID_CENTS, i.TENANT_ID || '|' || i.INVOICE_ID AS INVOICE_KEY, c.CUSTOMER_KEY, c.SEGMENT FROM DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_INVOICES AS i LEFT JOIN DMA_HEX.SILVER.BILLING_ADJUSTMENTS AS a ON i.TENANT_ID = a.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = a.INVOICE_ID LEFT JOIN payment_totals AS p ON i.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = p.INVOICE_ID LEFT JOIN DMA_HEX.GOLD.DIM_CUSTOMERS AS c ON i.TENANT_ID = c.TENANT_ID AND i.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID AND i.INVOICE_DATE >= c.VALID_FROM AND (i.INVOICE_DATE < c.VALID_TO OR c.VALID_TO IS NULL)) SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, INVOICE_DATE, INVOICE_MONTH, STATUS, AMOUNT_CENTS, ADJUSTMENT_CENTS, NET_CENTS, PAID_CENTS, NET_CENTS - PAID_CENTS AS OUTSTANDING_CENTS, INVOICE_KEY, CUSTOMER_KEY, SEGMENT FROM invoice_values

/* Current balances at the capture watermark, grouped by invoice date. Not payment-event-time cohorts. */ /* No customer-month segment: within-month changes need an approved allocation rule. */ WITH customer_month AS (SELECT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, INVOICE_MONTH, SUM(NET_CENTS) AS NET_CENTS, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS PAID_CENTS, SUM(OUTSTANDING_CENTS) AS OUTSTANDING_CENTS, MAX(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'posted' AND NET_CENTS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HAS_INVOICE, MAX(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'posted' AND PAID_CENTS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HAS_PAID_INVOICE FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES GROUP BY TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, INVOICE_MONTH), first_paid AS (SELECT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, MIN(INVOICE_MONTH) AS FIRST_PAID_MONTH FROM DMA_HEX.GOLD.FCT_INVOICES WHERE STATUS = 'posted' AND PAID_CENTS > 0 GROUP BY TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT m.TENANT_ID || '|' || m.CUSTOMER_ID || '|' || STRFTIME(m.INVOICE_MONTH, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CUSTOMER_MONTH_KEY, m.TENANT_ID, m.CUSTOMER_ID, m.INVOICE_MONTH, m.NET_CENTS, m.PAID_CENTS, m.OUTSTANDING_CENTS, m.HAS_INVOICE, m.HAS_PAID_INVOICE, p.FIRST_PAID_MONTH FROM customer_month AS m LEFT JOIN first_paid AS p ON m.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND m.CUSTOMER_ID = p.CUSTOMER_ID
